channel.title: Hermes Atlas — new projects
channel.description: Newly added community-built tools, skills, plugins, and integrations for Nous Research's Hermes Agent. Updated daily.

item.title: hermes-ui-plus (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: HUI+ is an unofficial mobile, web, and desktop client for interacting with your own Hermes Agent. It supports interactive answers, command approvals, and live viewing of tool steps; it requires a Hermes Agent and a bridge running alongside it.

item.title: fitatu_library (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: fitatu-api is an unofficial Python client for Fitatu that reads and writes food diary entries, activities, body measurements, water, and goals, and reads summaries and the food catalog. Its FitatuTools interface exposes tools for language models, and the project also provides an MCP server for compatible hosts.

item.title: alphapipeline (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: AlphaPipeline provides paid, per-call market and token-risk data through a REST API and a remote MCP server, using the x402 payment protocol on Base. Its tools include token security checks, DEX slippage and funding-rate data, Korea price premiums, Polymarket signals, and Hyperliquid prediction-market odds; the README says two onboarding tools and a Polymarket slippage preview are free.

item.title: hermes-console (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Console is an independent Android app for connecting to a self-hosted Hermes Agent through its Gateway and Dashboard, without a Console account or intermediary server. It provides chat with reasoning, tools, and tasks; voice conversations; bots and rooms; cron jobs; model management; and SSH, SFTP, and file viewing features.

item.title: hermes-blind (Memory & Context)
item.description: Hermes Blind deterministically extracts the first real user turn from supported local Claude Code or Codex session transcripts and generates an inspectable Markdown recovery anchor. It also provides an evidence-bound prompt wrapper for evaluation workflows and integration options for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Hermes Agent hooks.

item.title: Codeg (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Codeg brings multiple AI coding agents into one workspace, displaying their work as structured conversations. It can import, search, resume, and hand off agent session histories, and supports delegation between agents and queued tasks in separate worktrees. The README lists desktop, self-hosted server or Docker, iPhone, iPad, Android, Telegram, Lark, and WeChat access.

item.title: hermeneutic (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermeneutic provides a draft gate that flags fixed English wording patterns for review and a local correction-memory workflow that can retrieve guidance from past episodes for similar tasks. It can mine Claude Code session logs, and also supports Codex and OpenAI message logs; retrieval uses local embeddings and may return no guidance when nothing meets its threshold.

item.title: rule-audit (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: rule-audit statically analyzes AI system prompts and agent instructions, reporting logical contradictions, coverage gaps, priority ambiguities, meta-rule paradoxes, and absolute-rule edge cases without calling an LLM. It can run as a CLI or pre-commit hook and is available as a plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot CLI.

item.title: senpi-plugin (Domain Applications)
item.description: Senpi connects Hermes Agent to a user's hosted Senpi AI quant for Hyperliquid through an OAuth-authenticated MCP server and a companion skill. It supports market reads, ranked signals, wallet and trader research, portfolio analysis, and strategy design without requiring a deposit; Senpi documents a separate allow-once approval for proposed trades or fund movements, while deposits and withdrawals remain in its app.

item.title: astro-agents-mcp (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Astro Agents is a hosted MCP server that computes Western and Vedic astrology charts for AI agents, resolving time zones and historical offsets from coordinates. It uses NASA/JPL DE440 positions and returns deterministic results with SHA-256 input and result hashes that can be recomputed via a verification tool or REST endpoint. The repository documents the service and carries its MCP registry manifest; the engine runs at the hosted endpoint.

item.title: little-canary (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Little Canary screens untrusted prompts for signs of injection by sending the text to a powerless canary model with no tools or credentials, then inspecting the model's response for behavioral changes. It returns a PASS, FLAG, or BLOCK verdict for the host to enforce, with structural pattern checks running alongside. The README states the project publishes its corpora and method rather than a detection-rate headline.

item.title: ai-project-advisor (Domain Applications)
item.description: AI Project Advisor is a chat-based assistant for construction projects on WeCom, DingTalk, and H5. It turns messages into project records, tracks milestones and receivables, flags risks, and generates briefings; rule-based commands handle supported tasks, with an LLM fallback for open-ended questions and summaries.

item.title: memanto (Memory & Context)
item.description: Memanto is a companion agent that manages memories for other agents. It extracts durable knowledge from interactions, consolidates duplicates, reconciles conflicting information, applies forgetting policies, and briefs agents with relevant memories. It supports memory export and migration through the Open Knowledge Format.

item.title: agent-context-os (Memory & Context)
item.description: Context OS keeps durable project context and workflows in a Git-backed repository of Markdown files. Its adapters let supported coding agents use shared repository state, while reviewed setup, checkpoint, and close requests produce proposals and receipts.

item.title: hermes-tool-slimmer (Memory & Context)
item.description: Hermes Tool Slimmer is a plugin for Hermes Agent designed to reduce the token overhead of model requests by trimming tool schemas. It uses BM25 ranking to select relevant tools based on the user's request while maintaining a fallback mechanism for the model to request the full tool catalog.

item.title: ekko-studio (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows, available as a desktop app and a self-hosted web console. It supports Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and coding-agent integrations, with features including session management, platform channels, workflows, file tools, and usage views.

item.title: incise (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Incise is a CLI and agent-tool backend for making precise, byte-preserving edits to Markdown tables, lists, sections, and YAML frontmatter. Callers specify what should change by content-based addresses, and deterministic code handles formatting, boundaries, and the smallest possible splice. It is intended for AI-maintained documentation, Obsidian vaults, Markdown knowledge bases, and local models with limited context.

item.title: leverage (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Leverage provides a registry of skills and packaged workflows for AI agents, enabling them to access live social media data, company enrichment, and outreach tools. It integrates with agents via the agentskills.io standard and an MCP server to provide structured data from platforms like LinkedIn, X, and Reddit.

item.title: llm-wiki-cli (Memory & Context)
item.description: LWC is an agent-driven proactive memory CLI that lets AI agents recall, maintain, and evolve persistent, source-grounded knowledge across sessions. It turns curated documents into a durable Wiki with preserved sources, pages, citations, links, indexes, and history, and it does not require embeddings or a vector database. A self-hosted team memory option keeps core memory in local SQLite and Wiki files synchronized through a self-hosted server.

item.title: token-saver (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Token Saver is a Hermes Agent plugin that calculates the hypothetical cost of local AI inference based on live OpenRouter pricing. It tracks token usage from local providers like Ollama and LM Studio to visualize simulated savings through a web dashboard, TUI widget, and slash commands.

item.title: deja-vu (Memory & Context)
item.description: deja-vu indexes coding-agent session histories stored on disk so they can be searched and recalled across agents. It provides a terminal search interface and can return relevant past-session context during agent work; the README describes it as local, with no model or server required.

item.title: smartnumbers-hermes (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Smartnumbers receives and archives Smartnumbers conversation transcripts, with tools for searching archived turns and managing post-call reviews. When enabled, it can queue one-shot Hermes cron jobs for transcript reviews and user-configured callbacks.

item.title: hermes-codex-skin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Codex Skin is a plugin for Hermes Desktop that provides a Codex-inspired chat layout with Glass/Clear backgrounds, history previews, and an optional task Inbox. It offers settings for composer width, pinned user messages, and transcript display; Hermes retains control of native model menus, voice controls, and Queue behavior.

item.title: hermes-memoss (Developer Tools)
item.description: MemOS Memory Plugin for Hermes Agent connects to a self-hosted MemOS instance to provide persistent memory storage. It enables semantic search, fact extraction, and automatic synchronization of conversation turns.

item.title: hermes-hud (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Hermes HUD is a local-first, read-only monitoring plugin for the Hermes Agent dashboard that provides real-time observability of system health, token usage, and session activity. It operates as a user-level extension using a shared snapshot cache and WebSocket events to display metrics without outbound telemetry.

item.title: hermes-hud (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes HUD is a terminal-based consciousness monitor and dashboard for Hermes AI agents. It reads data from the agent's local directory to display live information regarding memory, tool usage, project status, and error logs.

item.title: skill-evolution (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Skill Evolution is a Python-based framework for autonomous agent skill improvement that analyzes past sessions to generate structured proposals. It features an evaluation gate with multiple evaluators and host-agnostic adapters for Hermes and Claude Code.

item.title: cli (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: SandBase CLI connects supported AI clients to SandBase models and APIs through a local MCP bridge. After browser authorization, clients can discover, inspect, and run available services; the README says data APIs are free and model calls are paid.

item.title: hermes-ai-usage (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes AI Usage Monitor is a read-only extension for Hermes Agent that provides telemetry for provider quotas and local token usage. It supports the native Desktop app and Web Dashboard, displaying session history and consumption metrics without reading prompt or message content.

item.title: hermes-speech (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Speech is a plugin for Hermes Agent 0.20+ that integrates text-to-speech and speech-to-text capabilities through the AllModels API. It enables conversational setup, voice searching, and streaming audio using Hermes' native provider interfaces and bundled dependencies.
